host: Apple M4 Max, 64 GiB, ambient load (not a 32 GB measurement)

changes_from_v1: every build question (build_triage, abstention_trap) carries a host-parsed STATUSES/COMPLETENESS block: exit codes come from `exit=N` lines and nowhere else; a cut-off code, a stage with no code, a planned stage with no line and one stage reporting two codes are each a completeness note (capability_bench::exit_facts); the parser reproduces every frozen expectation by construction (test the_host_verdict_agrees_with_every_frozen_expectation)

abstention traps ask 'Did every planned stage of this build record complete and pass?' instead of the FINAL-stage question, so variant 1 (a planned stage's result is absent) is undecidable rather than arguably PASS
the system prompt names the block as authoritative and status words (SUCCESS, PASS) as non-evidence
the answer is the first word after the last ANSWER: marker with quotes and markup stripped (v1 kept the whole line, which scored 'PARALLEL". Also we need…' as a false alarm)
output cap 160 tokens (v1: 96) and recorded in the summary; a run that hits the cap is a contract violation, never a guess
coverage_on_decidable excludes contract violations on decidable cases (v1 counted a missing answer as covered)
per-case output text (400 chars) is recorded so a violation is readable
product envelope: pam_model::engine_server::output_budget raises any positive max_tokens below 16 to 16 (gpt-oss returns raw harmony control tokens under that floor); 0 keeps its engine meaning
contract.comparability: v2 numbers are not comparable with the v1 screens (2026-09-12/13/14); the v1 records stay as history

runs.note: six missing answers: bt-038 (prose verdict, no marker) and all five PARALLEL pipeline cases, which spent the whole 96-token cap on inline analysis
two PARALLEL cases answered 'ANSWER: PARALLEL". Also we need to provide…' and the whole-line parser scored them as false alarms; jl-003/jl-027 still hit the cap; bt-038 unchanged

findings: Under the product contract gpt-oss-20b meets all three gates on this host: accuracy 0.980 (>=0.95), zero false passes, zero false alarms, zero over-abstentions, warm p95 593 ms.

Every v1 false pass and over-abstention was a contract artefact: with host-parsed exit facts and an unambiguous trap question the abstention family is 22/22 and build triage has no false pass, false alarm or over-abstention.

The remaining gap is three missing answers (2.0%): gpt-oss keeps reasoning inline on the two PARALLEL records with a failing first branch and exhausts 160 tokens before its answer line (reasoning_budget 0 does not stop that), and on bt-038 it states the verdict in prose without the marker. These count against accuracy and coverage, never as a pass.
Deterministic exit parsing owns exit truth in the product (#139 structured path); the model's role on build questions is to read the host's facts, which it now does without contradicting them.
